voice.summary: Speaks like a well-run small company handbook: plain, helpful and a little proud of how it is organised. People are named by role first, then by what they do.
dos: Say who works with whom in one line
donts: No hierarchy jargon like reports into
Never hide who leads a team

boilerplate: Kestrel Works is a twenty-person product company organised into product, engineering, design, operations and people teams, with a chart that shows who works with whom.
